rationale: ISO/IEC DIS 18013-5 Table 20 (s7.2.1) marks eleven elements M: family_name, given_name, birth_date, issue_date, expiry_date, issuing_country, issuing_authority, document_number, portrait, driving_privileges, un_distinguishing_sign. This entry carries all eleven. It previously carried four of them, which mattered more than a shortfall usually does because this file now drives both issuers rather than one port's literal - so every conformance check passed while PF and TypeScript faithfully issued a licence missing seven mandatory elements. driving_privileges is the one that makes it not a licence at all in any sense a reader cares about, and un_distinguishing_sign is the element with no analogue elsewhere in this catalogue, so it is the one least likely to be noticed missing. age_over_18 is NOT mandatory: it is a native mDL age attestation (s13.4.6), carried so the licence itself proves age by selective disclosure - the holder shows one boolean and withholds their date of birth.

claims.name: family_name
claims.note: Table 20 / 13.4.2: latin1b characters, at most 150. A value outside that is refused as missing (G-120).

claims.name: given_name
claims.note: Table 20 / 13.4.2: latin1b characters, at most 150. A value outside that is refused as missing (G-120).

claims.name: birth_date
claims.note: Table 20: full-date. The holder profile spells it birthdate (the SD-JWT name), so this reads that field and writes the ISO element name.

claims.name: issuing_country
claims.note: Table 20: alpha-2 per ISO 3166-1. s12.3.2.2 has the reader verify it against the DS certificate's countryName.

claims.name: issuing_authority
claims.note: Table 20 / 13.4.2: latin1b characters, at most 150. A value outside that is refused as missing (G-120).

claims.name: document_number
claims.note: Table 20 / 13.4.2: latin1b characters, at most 150. A value outside that is refused as missing (G-120).

claims.name: driving_privileges
claims.note: s7.2.4. Array of {vehicle_category_code, ?issue_date, ?expiry_date, ?codes}, dates as full-date INSIDE the map. NOTE 2 allows an empty array.

claims.name: un_distinguishing_sign
claims.note: Table 20: distinguishing sign per ISO/IEC 18013-1 Annex F - AUS for Australia, not the alpha-2 code. Left as text because it is neither alpha-2 nor alpha-3 in general.

claims.name: age_over_18
claims.note: Optional, not mandatory: s13.4.6 age attestation.
